promise: Huang forecast at least $1 trillion in Blackwell and Vera Rubin revenue cumulatively over 2025-2027.
description: At GTC 2026, Huang forecast cumulative revenue through 2027. The figure is an expectation, not booked revenue.
evidence: NVIDIA's March 16 keynote coverage gives the 2025-2027 period.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the forecast horizon remains future.

promise: Deliver equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027
description: At the March 2023 FIFA Congress, Infantino stated the ambition of equal payments for the men's 2026 and women's 2027 World Cups. Women's 2023 prize money was $110 million; FIFA later approved $655 million in prize money for the men's 2026 tournament. Women's 2027 parity remains to be assessed.
evidence: FIFA announced a parity ambition in March 2023; the women's 2027 tournament remains forthcoming.

promise: Provide at least €70 billion in military support for Ukraine in 2026, with an equivalent level planned for 2027
description: On July 8, 2026, NATO allies pledged EUR70 billion in military equipment, assistance and training for Ukraine during 2026 and at least an equivalent level in 2027. The record's final deadline covers the second year; the first tranche has its own end-2026 horizon.
evidence: Official summit text confirms the two annual commitments; final delivery is not yet due.

promise: Project at least $1 trillion in Blackwell and Vera Rubin demand and purchase orders through 2027
description: At GTC on March 16, 2026, Huang described visibility into at least $1 trillion of Blackwell and Vera Rubin demand and orders through 2027. This is a forecast, not recognized revenue.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: no completed, comparable order-pipeline accounting was located, and the forecast horizon remains open.

promise: Expect Optimus robots probably to be sold to the public by end-2027, subject to reliability and safety
description: Musk gave a conditional public-sale forecast at Davos in January 2026.
evidence: The forecast remains pending; the target year has not arrived.

promise: Provide Ukraine a 90-billion-euro loan to support its government and military over the next two years
description: The European Council agreed on December 19, 2025 to a EUR 90 billion loan for Ukraine's 2026-2027 needs, financed through EU market borrowing backed by the EU budget.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the Council decision establishes the financing commitment, but the retrieved source does not establish completed disbursement of the full amount.

promise: Commit up to EUR 73.7 million from Horizon Europe to CEPI for 2026-2027
description: The Commission announced the funding commitment during the World Health Assembly to support vaccine research and epidemic preparedness.
evidence: The May 19 announcement specifies a 2026-2027 funding period; full disbursement was not established.

promise: Invest 200 million euros in Greenland under a new EU-Greenland partnership announced in September 2026
description: Von der Leyen announced a EUR 200 million Global Gateway Partnership Package during her September 7, 2026 Nuuk visit, for investment in and with Greenland in 2026 and 2027.
evidence: The Commission's release establishes the amount and two calendar years; it is an investment commitment, not proof of all funds disbursed.

promise: Extend the Yarisi Bizden urban-transformation programme through December 31, 2027
description: Erdogan announced the extension after the September 7, 2026 Cabinet meeting, replacing the planned end-2026 termination.
evidence: Anadolu and TRT report the extension to December 31, 2027; the full period of programme availability remains prospective.

promise: End the double-track system in senior high schools by the end of 2027.
description: Mahama set a year-end 2027 target for ending the system that alternates student attendance to accommodate limited school capacity.
evidence: The presidency documented the commitment on September 11; Ghana News Agency reported a subsequent reiteration. These sources establish the target, not its fulfillment.

promise: Target commissioning the SDD-UBIDS library complex in 2027.
description: During a university visit, Mahama said he looked forward to commissioning the library complex in 2027. The due date represents the end of that stated target year, not an announced ceremony date.
evidence: The university's account of the September 12 visit records the 2027 target. Completion has not been established.
sources: SDD University of Business and Integrated Development Studies

promise: Aim to invest an additional C$10 billion in Canada by the end of 2027, subject to investment-return objectives.
description: The pension fund set a conditional investment objective, not an unconditional spending guarantee. Investments remain subject to its return requirements.
evidence: The fund's September 11 announcement states the amount, end-2027 horizon and return condition; Canada's summit release subsequently reported the commitment.
